title: Glitch Title
intent: Create an energetic opener or title card with chromatic aberration glitch text that animates immediately on load.
summary: CSS-only animated title frame with layered red and cyan offsets, scanlines, and short glitch bursts.

title: Data Rollup
intent: Create a compact data visualization frame with animated horizontal bars for labels and numeric values.
summary: Self-contained CSS and JavaScript bar chart that springs each bar width into place on load.

title: Liquid Hero
intent: Create a polished hero or opener frame with a flowing animated gradient background and centered headline.
summary: Self-contained animated gradient hero frame with headline, subtext, and soft liquid motion.
